verdict.rationale: Clara is a corporate card and spend-management platform, so consuming external MCP servers as a tool-using client falls outside its product role. Its documented MCP offering (clara-docs-4) is a Clara MCP server that lets outside AI assistants act on Clara data. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows Clara itself acting as an agent that connects to third-party MCP servers.
